decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot absorbed the role of the withdrawn standalone de-shuttering robot and remains central to the firm's automated precast production offering.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in integrated plant solutions and adds value at low marginal cost.
The automatic shuttering robot fits the firm's automation strategy, though the combined robot could eventually overlap with it as the standalone de-shuttering robot did.
The multi-model combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine line was only launched in 2024 and needs time to establish itself given long investment cycles.
Production analysis software supports the firm's lifecycle service and digitalization strategy at low ongoing cost.
